description: Build @minamorl/berylx npm tarball from clean commit and verify install, ESM imports, and workflow execution in an isolated directory
smoke: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { berylx, Workflow, Graph, VERSION } from "@minamorl/berylx"; import { berylx as browserBerylx } from "@minamorl/berylx/browser"; import { Timeline } from "@minamorl/berylx/timeline"; import { BerylxTimeline } from "@minamorl/berylx/timeline/berylx"; assert.equal(typeof VERSION, "string"); assert.ok(VERSION.length > 0); assert.equal(typeof browserBerylx, "function"); assert.equal(typeof Timeline, "function"); assert.equal(typeof BerylxTimeline, "function"); const b = berylx(); const trim = b.task("trim", (f) => f.at("name").update((s) => s.trim())); const greet = b.task("greet", (f) => f.at("greeting").set(`Hello, ${f.at("name").get()}!`)); const workflow = trim.then(greet); const root = b.root({ name: "  Mina  ", greeting: "" }); const res = root.pipe(workflow); assert.equal(res.isOk(), true); assert.deepEqual(res.focus.toObject(), { name: "Mina", greeting: "Hello, Mina!" }); assert.deepEqual(root.state(), { name: "Mina", greeting: "Hello, Mina!" }); const wfRes = Workflow.of("greet_wf", () => workflow).call({ name: "  Mina  ", greeting: "" }); assert.equal(wfRes.isOk(), true); assert.deepEqual(wfRes.focus.toObject(), { name: "Mina", greeting: "Hello, Mina!" }); assert.deepEqual(Graph.from(workflow).nodes(), ["trim", "greet"]); console.log("BERYLX_SMOKE_OK", VERSION);'
